item.title: [IGNITE-2615] SQL query fails for cache with an eviction policy to offheap

item.summary: SQL query fails for cache with an eviction policy to offheap

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment: Artem, given you you are working on the test suites now, can you please make sure that this is part of a test?

This error was possible with configuration when offheap is configured with limited size and swap is disabled. In this case when value was evicted from offheap it was just lost, but for correct queries work evicted value should be passed to indexing.

Fixed issue with entry evicted from offheap in master (commit a6b3ded).

Sergey, please verify.
